payload.summary: Release one exact reviewed npm artifact through generated-version-first, script-disabled, absent-directory and exact-artifact gates, then publish only those reviewed tarball bytes after explicit maintainer approval.
gates: Use a fresh isolated writable npm cache; run the direct generated-version check before bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts, then typecheck, full tests, lint, benchmark check and reproducible build.

Move any previous disposable package-artifacts directory to a private backup so the retained destination is absent; create and atomically retain one complete tarball-and-sidecar directory, then run the shared fixed-path sidecar/content preflight.

Recheck the supplied tarball, run dual-hash v0.2 upgrade/downgrade compatibility, tarball-only publish dry run, direct built CLI validation and strict worktree/diff hygiene against the same repository-relative pair.
Record byte size, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 and npm integrity; require reviewed/main CI artifact byte identity before publication.
payload.publication: Publication is a manual tarball-only action: npm publish <reviewed-candidate.tgz>. Never rebuild or publish a directory, and never upload without the maintainer final explicit approval after merge and green main.
